newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bollore confirms buyout plans for SDV.
newsitem.headline: Bollore confirms buyout plans for SDV.

text.p: Bollore Technologies said on Tuesday its board had approved plans to buy out its 73.83 percent transport unit Scac Delmas Vileujeux (SDV) and invited shareholders to tender their shares.

Under the bid, whose terms were first announced on July 19, shareholders are being offered the choice of 1,100 francs per share, paid in two instalments, or the exchange of one SDV share for a bond with a nominal value of 1,180 francs and paying annual interest of 4.25 percent, convertible into two Bollore shares on January 1, 2002.
French insurance group Axa which holds 17.67 percent of the capital of SDV said that it would tender half of its shares to the purchase offer and half to the exchange offer.
